sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Spl. Case No.257 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Balasore, arising out of Basta P.S. Case No.247 of 2022 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 448/
366-A/ 506/ 120-B/ 109/ 376(2)(n)/ 34 of IPC and U/S 6/ 8 of POCSO Act.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel that omnibus allegations have been made.

Petitioner Nos.1 and 3, being the brother-in-law, and Petitioner No.2, being the brother of the principal accused,
have been falsely implicated in the case at hand.
Hence, the Petitioners may be protected by pre-arrest bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail.
5. This Court perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 183 of BNSS.

sentences.text: Taking note of the same, this Court is not inclined to entertain the application for pre-arrest bail in respect of Petitioner No.3.

However, in the event the Petitioner No.3 (Kuna @ Jhadeswar Jena)
surrenders before the learned Court in seisin in the aforesaid case and moves an application for his release on bail, the same shall be considered on its own merit.

7. So far as the ABLAPL in respect of Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 is concerned, taking into account the nature of allegations and their complicity in the case, this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 (Sapan Ku. Das and Tukuna @
Bijay Mohanty respectively) shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper.
8. It is needless to state that the Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.
9. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Jina Location: High Court of Orissa Date: 24-Dec-2025 14:39:10
